chars.HUDA: HUDA: a 23-year-old Moroccan woman with long dark wavy hair worn loose, wearing an oversized lilac hoodie with white drawstrings and grey jogger pants
chars.BABA: BABA: a Moroccan father about 55, short grey hair, neatly trimmed grey beard, wearing a cream djellaba with thin brown stripes and reading glasses hanging on a cord
chars.MAMA: MAMA: a Moroccan mother about 50, round warm face, wearing a mustard-yellow house kaftan and a navy blue headscarf

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Seen from the bedroom doorway, early morning light through the window of a modest apartment bedroom in Kenitra, Morocco. BABA sits on the edge of HUDA's bed leaning toward her, face clearly visible, serious and worried; HUDA lies under a blanket, sad, puffy eyes. Head-to-waist framing, both in the centre of the frame.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Medium close-up of BABA sitting on the edge of a bed in a Moroccan bedroom, morning light, gesturing with one open hand while talking gently but firmly, worried tired eyes.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: BABA puts a tender hand on HUDA's shoulder as she sits up in bed under a blanket, he looks at her with a soft fatherly expression, she looks down. Moroccan bedroom, morning light.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: HUDA sitting up in her bed, hands pressed together pleading, eyes wide and hopeful, talking to BABA who listens thoughtfully stroking his grey beard. Moroccan bedroom, morning.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: BABA standing in the bedroom doorway of a Moroccan apartment, half-turned, with a small reluctant smile, pointing toward the kitchen as if saying get up and have breakfast.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: HUDA alone in her bedroom jumping on her bed with joy, arms raised, huge smile, hair flying, blanket tossed, morning sunlight. Comic happy moment.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: HUDA sitting cross-legged on her bed, typing a message on her smartphone with both thumbs, grinning excitedly, phone screen facing away from the viewer. Moroccan bedroom, morning.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan family breakfast at a small low table with mint tea glasses, msemen and olives in a Kenitra apartment living room; BABA in the background walking out through the front door; MAMA and HUDA seated at the table.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: At the breakfast table, MAMA leans across toward HUDA with one raised eyebrow and narrowed suspicious eyes, holding a tea glass; HUDA answers excitedly with big gestures and a guilty grin. Comic interrogation, Moroccan living room.
